message.content: Propose a water-budget team without bulbasaur, charmander or squirtle. Keep all the usual constraints: 3 distinct allowed Pokemon, at most 1000 combined base stats, at least one Water type. Do not spar.

relevance: The final team has exactly three distinct members from the 151 Generation I species, default varieties only; at least one is Water type and the combined base-stat total is at most 1000. Every final member has a successful pokemon_retrieve result; reported types and stat_total agree with those results (sum all six stats[].base_stat per member). Missing or failed evidence does not pass. Generation membership is supported by successful generation_retrieve or pokemon_species_retrieve evidence; final pokemon_retrieve results show default varieties whose species match the chosen names.
The final team excludes bulbasaur, charmander and squirtle, respects the user preference without changing the arena constraints, and has empty sparring. No spar_team call was made.
